title: 3.1 Overtime Pay
prompt: 3.1 Write a program to prompt the user for hours and rate per hour using input to compute gross pay. Pay the hourly rate for the hours up to 40 and 1.5 times the hourly rate for all hours worked above 40 hours. The autograder will provide the hours and rate as input (for the sample data, the pay should be 498.75).
learning_objective: Use if/else to pay overtime (1.5x) for hours worked above 40.
hint: If hours are over 40, pay the first 40 at the normal rate and the rest at 1.5 times the rate.
solution_explanation: Regular hours are paid at the hourly rate. Hours above 40 are paid at 1.5 times the rate; an if/else chooses which formula to use.

student.py.solution:
hrs = input("Enter Hours:")
rate = input("Enter Rate:")
h = float(hrs)
r = float(rate)
if h <= 40:
    pay = h * r
else:
    pay = 40 * r + (h - 40) * r * 1.5
print(pay)
